gloss: new place to move to; moving destination

definitions.gloss: new place to move to; moving destination
definitions.explanation: The place where someone is moving to or has moved to. Refers to the destination of a residential or office move.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧？
examples.english: Have you decided where you're moving to?

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the address of your new place.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{遠|とお}くて→遠い：00529_tooi⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}ら→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: My new place is far from the station, so I have to take the bus every morning.

notes:
Compound of {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し (moving, relocation) + ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination). Used when talking about the place someone is relocating to.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: the new place is decided
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a new place to live
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: the address of the new place

RELATED WORDS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: the act of moving
- ⟦{転居先|てんきょさき}→転居先：29866_tenkyosaki⟧: new address (more formal)
- {移転先|いてんさき}: relocation destination (often for businesses)
